messages:
Lina: Quick heads-up  we9re running a precision copy pass for Hosted / Dedicated / Private hero sections next week. goal: clearer intent routing + a small webinar banner. who can draft tight variants?
Omar: I can. proposing three headline frames: fast time-to-value, predictable economics, security & control. keep headlines under 9 words.
Priya: measurement focus: lift in qualified leads (score >= 30) and webinar signups. also split inbound by product intent so sales can prioritize.
Sam: product notes: Dedicated must have a short SLA + "reserved GPU pools" line. Private needs KMS + audit logs + optional on-prem mention. Hosted should highlight quick onboarding and curated model catalog.
Lina: CTAs: Hosted = "Start free trial"; Dedicated = "Request reserved capacity"; Private = "Contact sales". Webinar banner CTA = "Save my seat" (separate list). add microcopy under CTA (privacy/trial).
Omar: experiment matrix idea: 3 frames x 3 pages x 2 tones (developer vs enterprise) = 18 variants. run 72h split, then reweight. utm_campaign=precision_hero_jun2026, utm_content=variant_{id}.
Priya: HubSpot routing plan (to implement):
- hosted form -> list: lp_hosted_precision; lead_source=precision_531246
- dedicated form -> list: lp_dedicated_precision; lead_source=precision_531246
- private form -> list: lp_private_precision; lead_source=precision_531246
- webinar -> list: webinar_precision; lead_source=precision_531246_banner
Sam: Dedicated qual fields: desired qps, monthly token estimate, preferred region. If token_estimate > 300M then route to AE queue. Private form should collect security contact + compliance needs.
BotTracker: staging links created: https://staging.redwood/track/pH1 (hosted), https://staging.redwood/track/pD2 (dedicated), https://staging.redwood/track/pP3 (private), webinar: https://staging.redwood/track/pW4. webhooks scheduled Wed 09:00 PT. :robot_face:
Omar: copy checklist for each variant: headline (<=9 words), 1-sentence subhead, primary CTA label, CTA microcopy (privacy/trial), 1 short feature chip (<=30 chars), optional webinar banner. avoid vague superlatives.
Lina: owners: Omar (copy), Priya (tracking + baseline), Sam (product review + qual fields), BotTracker (links). deliverables: drafts by Tue EOD, staging Wed, launch Thu.
Priya: posting baseline: Hosted CTR 3.0%, Dedicated CTR 1.1%, Private CTR 0.7%, webinar banner CTR 0.9%. target lifts: +0.4% CTR hosted, +0.3% CTR dedicated, +0.2% CTR private, and +15% webinar signups.
Sam: small ask: Dedicated should include a 10-word tech snippet: "SLA-backed latency, autoscaling reserved GPU pools". Private add: "KMS + audit logs" as chip.
Omar: will post first tone variants by 16:30 PT. keep feedback quick so we can iterate.
Lina: thanks team  keep language concrete and testable. reconvene Thu 09:15 to review initial data. :white_check_mark:
